::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 19th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 68-69
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Thank you first for your answer about magazine rights. I am going to try the paper a little longer.[^1]

Next thanks for [the account](organizations/other_160.qmd). I am very glad to know what I  have to look to. I suppose scarcity of money tells more on the sale of books than anything else, but all things considered this is very good for the year 1878.

If I find that I want £100 or £150 in advance about Christmas, I dare say you will be kind enough to let me have it

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: She had asked him whether, having accepted a series of articles, she was obliged to go on publishing them regardless of quality.
